meta.title: Tokenization, encryption and masking compared
meta._note: Invented example for the custom scene seam (one record, many viewers). The card number is a published test number and the cardholder and email are placeholders. Every view, count and comparison cell is computed from the record, the protections, the viewers and the access flags by the scene.

steps.title: One record, as it arrives
steps.body: A customer payment record holds a name, card number, email and amount. Every system starts from this readable copy.

steps.title: Protections applied side by side
steps.body: The same record gets a different protection in each column. Each character changes as the sweep passes, so the results can be compared directly.

steps.title: What the processor sees
steps.body: Charging the card needs the real number, so the processor recovers it in every column.

steps.title: Order, analytics and support
steps.body: The order service holds the key but not the vault. Analytics holds neither. Support can ask the vault but sees masked screens. Each protection treats them differently.

steps.title: What a stolen copy gives
steps.body: A thief copies the database and reads what is stored. Tokens and ciphertext are useless; display masking leaves the originals.

steps.title: Which protection fits which job
steps.body: Tokens suit data that only needs matching, encryption suits data that must come back, and display masking suits screens. None replaces the others.

protections.name: Tokenization
protections.define: Swaps each value for a stand-in of the same shape. The original waits in a vault.
protections.fits: Tokenization fits data other systems only need to match or route.

protections.name: Encryption
protections.define: Scrambles each value with a key. Anyone holding the key can unscramble it.
protections.fits: Encryption fits data its owners must store and later read back.

protections.name: Masking
protections.define: Hides part of a value on screen. This is display masking: the store keeps the original.
protections.fits: Masking fits screens and reports where people need only a hint.

viewers.name: Payment processor
viewers.needs: Charges the card, so it has the key, vault access and unmasked screens.

viewers.name: Order service
viewers.needs: Sends receipts and tracks orders. It holds the key but cannot use the vault.

viewers.name: Analytics team
viewers.needs: Totals sales and spots trends. It has no key, no vault and masked screens.

viewers.name: Support agent
viewers.needs: Helps customers by phone. It can use the vault but has no key and masked screens.

viewers.name: Thief with a copy
viewers.needs: Holds a copy of the stored data. It has no key, no vault and no screens.
